title: LifestealX
description: LifestealX is a premium-quality Lifesteal plugin for Minecraft servers
body:
**LifestealX** is a premium Minecraft server plugin that adds a lifesteal system where players gain hearts by eliminating others and lose hearts when they die, creating a high-stakes survival experience.

## Features include

✨ Advanced Lifesteal System

✨ Heart Withdrawal System

✨ Prestige System

✨ Revive Tokens

✨ PlaceholderAPI Support

✨ Custom Effects & Particles

✨ Configurable Recipes

✨ Optimized Performance

✨ Spigot & Paper Support

## Player Commands

/lifesteal hearts

/lifesteal withdraw <amount>
  
/lifesteal prestige

/lifesteal revive

## Admin Commands

/lifesteal giveheart <player> <amount>
  
/lifesteal sethearts <player> <amount>
  
/lifesteal reload

/lifesteal reviveplayer <player>
